gen_system: You help a player write their own character. Write only this field's text, no title, no explanation. Concrete and vivid; no world lore.
example: You grew up in a rainy city and moved house seven times. At sixteen you bought a novel with no ending from a used-book stall, and ever since you have written everything down in a notebook. You still owe someone an apology you never said.
